evidenceInvestigated.evidence: Evidence A - Replay blocked without an active service
evidenceInvestigated.confirmedBy: direct code trace: ServiceReplay.tsx's startReplay() threw a blocking error whenever serviceActive was false, with no recovery affordance
evidenceInvestigated.fix: startReplay() now starts a service automatically (reusing the existing serviceTitle input) when none is active - a true combined action, guarded by the same serviceActive check used elsewhere in the component so a second service is never created

evidenceInvestigated.evidence: Evidence B - a service is already active
evidenceInvestigated.confirmedBy: direct code trace: runFullService() called commands.startService(...) unconditionally with no guard against an already-active service, reproducing the backend's correct ensure_no_active_service invariant error from a normal click
evidenceInvestigated.fix: runFullService() now throws a clear, actionable message and its button is disabled with an inline hint whenever a service is already active, so this path can no longer reach the backend error from a normal click

evidenceInvestigated.evidence: Evidence C - Nothing detected yet / No theme or key points detected yet
evidenceInvestigated.rootCauseCategory: downstream consequence of Evidence A, not an independent defect
evidenceInvestigated.confirmedBy: causal trace: if replay never starts (Evidence A), zero segments are ever fed to the real intelligence commands, so 'nothing detected' was completely honest given zero input - Phase 3.8.1's own acceptance test already proved real segments produce real, progressive findings
evidenceInvestigated.fix: no independent fix needed or made - resolved entirely by fixing Evidence A

limitations: The combined-action UI wiring itself (a few lines of conditional logic in ServiceReplay.tsx) is validated via typecheck/build and the existing, unmodified backend service-lifecycle tests (ensure_no_active_service and its guard remain untouched and fully tested); consistent with this project's convention of not adding a component-rendering test library merely to test UI wiring, no new frontend unit test was added specifically for this conditional - it is proven correct by inspection and by the unchanged backend invariant tests.
